DDA to Develop 5-Star Hotel in Dwarka

The Delhi Development Authority (DDA) has signed an agreement to develop a 5-star hotel in Sector 23, Dwarka. The project is expected to be completed by 2030. This development aims to enhance hospitality infrastructure in the area.
